source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.7 with Example 4.4 (PDF 85-87).

blocks.text: Jab bhi kisi body (jism) par work kiya jaye, us ki energy barhti hai. Maslan m mass ki body initial velocity v_i se chal raha hai; us par force F faasle d tak lagti hai aur us ki velocity v_f ho jati hai. To paida hone wali acceleration:

blocks.title: Tid-bits
blocks.text: Aap din bhar mein jo khana khate hain us mein taqreeban utni energy hoti hai jitni ⅓ litre petrol mein.
Eqs. 4.16 aur 4.17 ko barabar rakhne se:

blocks.text_alt: ya   Fd = ½ mv_f² − ½ mv_i²   (4.18)

blocks.text: Yeh expression work-energy theorem hai. Yeh kehta hai:

blocks.title: Work-energy theorem
blocks.text: Kisi cheez ki kinetic energy mein tabdeeli us work ke barabar hai jo net (khalis) force us par karti hai.

blocks.text_alt: W = K.E. ki tabdeeli = (K.E)_f − (K.E)_i = ½ mv_f² − ½ mv_i²

blocks.text: Isay work-energy principle bhi kehte hain.

Work-energy theorem force ki har direction (simt) ke liye lagta hai, chahe force displacement ke saath ho ya khilaf. Maslan chalti hui cheez kisi doosri cheez ko dhakel ya kheench kar work kar sakti hai; is soorat mein us par work negative liya jata hai aur us ki kinetic energy kam ho jati hai. Agar force jagah jagah badalti rahe tab bhi theorem theek rehta hai.

blocks.title: Example 4.4
blocks.problem: 60 kg ka motorcycle sawar 24° ki slope (dhalan) par engine ke baghair neeche aa raha hai (coasting). Motorcycle ka mass 30 kg hai. Slope ki choti (top) par speed 3.2 m s⁻¹ hai. Agar kinetic friction ki force 100 N ho, to 72 m neeche speed kya hogi?
steps: Normal force F_N, weight ke us hisse (mg cos 24°) ko barabar kar deti hai jo slope par perpendicular hai. Friction f hai, to slope ke saath neeche net force F:
F = mg sin 24° − f, jahan m = kul mass = 60 kg + 30 kg = 90 kg
Work positive hai, to work-energy theorem se: W = (K.E.)_f − (K.E.)_i, yani (K.E.)_f = W + (K.E.)_i
45 kg × v_f² = 18661.8 J, to v_f² = 414.7 m² s⁻²

blocks.alt: Sawar ke saath motorcycle ek seedhi slope (dhalan) par jo horizontal zameen se 24 degree par daen taraf uthti hai.
blocks.caption: Example 4.4 (PDF page 86): 24 degree ki slope par motorcycle (kitab ki is example wali tasveer ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.alt: Free-body diagram: dashed slope dashed horizontal lakeer se 24 degree par. Slope ke ek point par: F_N slope se bahar, friction (ragar) f slope par oopar, mg sin 24 degree slope par neeche, weight mg seedha neeche aur mg cos 24 degree slope ke andar, mg se 24 degree par. Patli lakeer mg aur mg cos 24 ki nokon ko jorti hai, us par mg sin 24.
blocks.caption: Example 4.4 (PDF page 86): slope par motorcycle par forces (kitab ki is example wali tasveer ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Weight mg ke do hisse hain: mg cos 24° slope ke andar ki taraf, jise F_N barabar kar deti hai, aur mg sin 24° slope ke saath neeche. Friction f slope ke saath oopar ki taraf hai, is liye net force F = mg sin 24° − f hai, jo motorcycle ko neeche le jati hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ki is example mein “Wok done” aur “Form here” chhape hain; yeh sirf spelling ki ghaltiyan hain (sahi: Work done, From here). Kitab sawar aur motorcycle ka “weight” kg mein likhti hai; asal mein yeh mass hai (weight newton mein hota hai).

blocks.caption: Theorem ko samajhna
rows: Net force motion ke khilaf (friction, doosri cheez ko dhakelti body)
phir bhi K.E. ki tabdeeli ke barabar

blocks.prompt: 14 m s⁻¹ se chalti gend par force lagti hai aur us ki speed 6 m s⁻¹ kar deti hai. Force ne positive work kiya ya negative (constructed response 4.4)? Oonchai H se giri body 1.2 √(gH) speed se zameen par pohnchta hai; hawa ki friction ne kitna work kiya (short question 4.8)?
blocks.explanation: Gend ki kinetic energy kam hui, to theorem ke mutabiq net work negative hai: force motion ke opposite (ulat) thi. Friction na ho to zameen par speed √(2gH) hoti aur K.E. = mgH. Asal K.E. = ½ m (1.44 gH) = 0.72 mgH. Gravity ne +mgH work kiya aur kul tabdeeli 0.72 mgH hai, to hawa ki friction ka work = 0.72 mgH − mgH = −0.28 mgH.

items: 2ad = v_f² − v_i² aur F = ma se: Fd = ½ mv_f² − ½ mv_i² (4.18).
Net force ka work = kinetic energy ki tabdeeli; har direction aur badalti force ke liye bhi; negative work K.E. ghatata hai. Example 4.4: 72 m neeche 20.4 m s⁻¹.
